title: Long time smooth solutions of 3D cubic quasilinear wave systems with small weakly decaying initial data
summary: For the 3D cubic quasilinear wave system $\square_{c_i} u^i=G^i(u,\partial u,\partial^2u)=\displaystyle\sum_{\substack{0\le|α|,|β|,|γ|\le1 \\ 1\le j,k,l \le m}}g_{αβγ}^{ijkl}\partial^αu^j\partial^βu^k\partial^γu^l$, it is well known that global solution $u$ exists when the small smooth initial data $(u,\partial_tu)|_{t=0}$ $=(u_0(x), u_1(x))$ are compactly supported or decay rapidly at spatial infinity.
